name: Clone instrument
action: clone instrument NEEDS >=1 CHECKED ROW (dm.instruments.select-index.{index}) — with none checked the app shows an error toast and no modal opens.

name: Mass edit instruments
action: mass edit NEEDS >=2 CHECKED ROWS — with exactly ONE checked the app opens the per-instrument EDIT dialog (#addInstrumentModal) instead; with none, an error toast.

name: Clone session
action: clone session NEEDS >=1 CHECKED ROW (dm.sessions.select-index.{index}) — with none checked the app shows an error toast and no modal opens.

action: import NinjaTrader 8 Trading Hours templates as sessions - opens a confirm naming the folder and the template count; existing sessions are skipped, holidays are not imported
